item.title: How to enable GPG signing in Git
item.description: Enabling GPG signing for Git commits ensures commit authenticity and maintains security in collaborative projects and open-source repositories. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve enforced commit signing in production repositories. The most straightforward approach is configuring Git to automatically sign all commits with your GPG key. This method provides cryptographic proof of authorship for every commit you make.
